title: Phase 1 polish: RFC compliance, dead code, safety checks
description:
What: Resolve highest-value P3 open items before Phase 2 work begins.

Why: Phase 1 MVP is complete and stable. These items reduce technical debt and close small correctness gaps before adding Phase 2 features. Doing them now keeps the codebase clean and avoids carrying dead code/missing RFC features into Phase 2.

Items grouped by category:

1. RFC compliance: KITH-c2i — kith-events must support ?ping= query parameter per RFC 8620 §7.3
2. Dead code removal: KITH-626.17 (WhoIsNode.addresses unused), KITH-626.18 (profile_pic_url dead), KITH-626.20 (StatusResponse.backend_state unused)
3. Compile-time safety: KITH-a01 — add compile/test check so METHOD_ROLES and register() cannot drift
4. Test coverage: KITH-v7t.11 — KITH_DB_PATH bare-filename edge case untested
5. Refactoring: KITH-46h (extract counter tx pattern), KITH-69c (row-to-message helper), KITH-626.14 (LocalAPI request boilerplate)

Outcome: No dead fields in public API types, RFC 8620 §7.3 ping compliance, compile-time guard against method registry drift.
